name: The Unofficial Homestuck Collection
tagline: Offline collection of Homestuck and its related works
blurb: The Unofficial Homestuck Collection is a heavily customised browser built from the ground up to support offline reading of Homestuck and its related works.
description:
The Unofficial Homestuck Collection is a heavily customised browser built from the ground up to support offline reading of Homestuck and its related works.

The Asset Pack V2 is required for the application to function. This is a separate download that can be found on the homepage.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
